rows.grounds: verb indicating attainment of the state described in prior verses
compound qualifying the practitioners by their steadfast intelligence
adjective expressing the blessed condition of those who attain
compound denoting practitioners united in yoga with Śiva

items.question: Which practitioners are fortunate enough to attain the liberated state?
premises: Certain practitioners are characterized as greatly wise.
These practitioners are devoted to yoga with Śiva.
Such practitioners are described as fortunate.
items.inference: Therefore, the greatly wise and fortunate Śiva-yogins attain the liberated state.
items.plain_english: Indeed, the greatly wise and fortunate Śiva-yogins attain that state.
